verdict.rationale: Orama documents a bulk-insert path: `insertMultiple` is recommended for large record sets, avoids blocking the event loop, and has a configurable batch size (default 1000). Orama Cloud data sources can also be updated independently. However, the evidence never shows async task or job tracking that reports when indexing completes, and nothing demonstrates throughput at millions of documents. missing for 10: async indexing task/status tracking, evidence of million-document-scale import performance, Cloud bulk-ingestion API docs, independent benchmarks or hands-on corroboration.
